headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson Suffers Ankle Injury
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson exited Sunday’s win over the Titans just before halftime with an ankle injury, raising uncertainty about his availability for next Monday’s matchup with the Falcons. After losing Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton to injury during the game, Kansas City is now “very interested” in re-signing their former wide receiver, according to Mike Silver of The Athletic. headline: Kyle Juszczyk (knee), two more 49ers injured in win over Broncos
summary: For the fourth straight week, the 49ers clawed out a victory but were unable to come out of the game against the Broncos without injury concerns.

headline: Lions, Sam LaPorta Break Off Negotiations

headline: Tetairoa McMillan, Bryce Young star as Panthers defeat Lions
summary: Carolina receiver Tetairoa McMillan was dominant in his team's 32-36 win over Detroit Lions Sunday night, catching 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns from teammate Bryce Young, who threw for 329 yards to help the Panthers even their record at 2-2.

headline: Macdonald laments 'unacceptable' penalties in Seahawks' win
summary: Thea Seahawks set a club record with 150 penalty yards in Sunday's win over the Chargers, something coach Mike Macdonald said his team would need to clean up.
